PROVISIONING.TITLE: Database & Account Setup
PROVISIONING.DESCRIPTION: Provision a dedicated Marine PostgreSQL database and a single login account. This runs only when you click Create and applies to the whole installation, so it is restricted to administrators of the current account only.
PROVISIONING.NOT_CONFIGURED: Provisioning is not available: the server-side provisioning credential is not configured. Contact your administrator.

FORM.HELP: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores only; must start with a letter or underscore; 63 characters max.

CREDENTIALS_DIALOG.TITLE: Save these credentials now
CREDENTIALS_DIALOG.WARNING: This is the only time the password will be shown. Store it securely — it can never be retrieved again.
CREDENTIALS_DIALOG.ACKNOWLEDGE_CHECKBOX: I have securely saved these credentials, including the password.

PRIVILEGES.TITLE: Privilege Management
PRIVILEGES.DESCRIPTION: Adjust or inspect the Marine login account's privileges. Each action runs only when you click its button.

MATRIX.CHATWOOT_CONNECT: Can CONNECT to Chatwoot DB (must be No)

CONFIRM.DOWNGRADE_BODY: The login will keep read/write access to Marine tables but lose the ability to create or own objects.
CONFIRM.REVOKE_BODY: The login will lose all privileges and be set to NOLOGIN. No database, schema, tables or data are deleted.

ALERTS.GENERIC_ERROR: The provisioning request could not be completed.
